audio_music: An upbeat, confident hip-hop track with a strong beat and male rap vocals plays throughout the video, creating a hype atmosphere. Lyrics include "standing on business" and "big stepper."
editing_pacing: The video uses slow-motion and a consistent low-angle shot to create a dramatic and powerful portrayal of the subject. The pacing is deliberate and not fast-cut.
